content: npm 'qrcode' (soldair/node-qrcode) is the standard Node.js QR library: outputs png/svg/utf8, supports error correction levels L/M/Q/H (default M). For logo-overlay QR codes, level H (highest redundancy, ~30% correction) is recommended since the logo occupies module area. SVG output is composable (easy to inject a logo <image> element and re-render), PNG needs canvas-based compositing (node-canvas or sharp) to overlay a logo bitmap onto the generated QR raster.
